Theme

Latin word

fortasse

adverb

maybe, perhaps

In this lexicon

  • perhaps

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Div. Caec. 40: fortasse dīcēs; Traupman 344

Notes

  1. 1fortasse: short final e (Lewis & Short fortassē, without evidence). Catull. 85.1, Ōdī et amō. quārē id faciam fortasse requīris: the fifth foot, -tasse re-, is a dactyl. Also Hor. S. 1.3.20, 1.6.98. De Vaan 236, s.v. fors: “short final vowel”. Ruling: fortasse with a short final e.
